headline: CDN edge serves each day's bake trail truncated at ~06:00 ET for ~24h (73 of 290 rows), so the sheet's yesterday view and the bake's execution score read morning rows; cache-buster fix on this branch. The tuner's live spread court also undoes its own sd_mult step the next night.
